title: ALPHABET: A Laplace-Pole History Aggregator with Banked Exponential Transport
abstract: arXiv:2608.24051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a sequence model remain competitive with only a few thousand parameters and an explicitly auditable prediction interface? We introduce ALPHABET, a compact linear-time model that compresses temporal history into stable complex pole modes: a direct bank synthesizes its modal states back into the feature trajectory, an independent cascaded bank analyzes the transformed trajectory without resynthesis, and an affine head reads only modal energies and lag moments from both banks. We characterize the temporal information this descriptor retains: for a stationary, fully observed feature process, each mode energy is a frequency-localized measurement of the second-order spectrum, the continuum of such measurements identifies the spectrum, and almost every mode separates any fixed finite set of spectrally distinct classes. translated_title: ALPHABET：一种带分组指数传输的拉普拉斯极点历史聚合器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24051v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：一个序列模型能否仅凭几千个参数和明确可审计的预测接口保持竞争力？我们引入了ALPHABET，这是一种紧凑的线性时间模型，将时间历史压缩为稳定的复极点模式：一个直接分组将其模态状态合成回特征轨迹，一个独立的级联分组分析变换后的轨迹而不进行再合成，一个仿射头仅从两个分组读取模态能量和滞后矩。我们刻画了该描述符保留的时间信息：对于平稳、完全观测的特征过程，每个模态能量是二阶谱的频域局部测量，此类测量的连续体可识别谱，且几乎每个模态都能区分任何固定的有限谱不同类别集合。在具有匹配低滞后统计的高斯控制实验中，学习到的描述符接近贝叶斯最优解，其中原始自协方差...
tldr: 本文提出ALPHABET，一种仅用数千参数即可实现线性时间序列压缩的模型，通过极点模式保留谱信息并达到接近贝叶斯最优的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ALPHABET, a compact linear-time model that compresses temporal history via pole modes with only a few thousand parameters, achieving near-Bayes-optimal performance by retaining spectral information.
